【原视频简介】
This was our most challenging free clean yet!

The elderly resident had just six days before the council returned to carry out essential safety checks, and if the property wasn’t made safe and accessible in time, she would lose her home. The flat was heavily hoarded, there was an active mice infestation, most of the furniture had been destroyed, and years of grief and declining mental health had left the resident struggling to cope.

In this video, we clear and deep clean the entire flat, remove damaged furniture, tackle years of nicotine, grease and grime, and refurnish the home before the deadline.

This free clean cost £4,578, but most importantly, the resident was able to keep her home and is now receiving ongoing support.

Please do not attempt to identify, contact or harass the resident or her family.

❤️ Thank you for watching and supporting the free clean programme.
